recipe_policy: One fixed recipe; no HPO or test-based tuning
seed_interpretation: One predeclared training seed (42) per split. No best-seed selection. Across-split dispersion is not a fixed-split repeated-seed uncertainty estimate; equal seed does not imply identical stochastic trajectories across different split sizes/order.
training_selection: Best checkpoint selected by raw validation MAE; early stopping patience20, at most200epochs. Official test never selects configuration, seed, checkpoint or stopping.
restart_policy: Every distinct run starts from scratch. Interrupted same-run continuation may use only its own source-bound last.pt, never another split/target checkpoint.
evaluation_policy: Dedicated final evaluator is supplied separately by the parent task; this plan and frozen training runner do not evaluate test.
